name: @runneros/printing-press-spotify-cli
description: Spotify browser harness for RunnerOS: Spotify for Artists snapshots and Spotify web-player playlist creation.

scripts.smoke: node src/cli.mjs --help && node src/cli.mjs profile list --json && node src/cli.mjs playlist spotify create --profile smoke --name "Late Night Drive" --tracks spotify:track:4iV5W9uYEdYUVa79Axb7Rh --visibility private --dry-run --json
